about: Request and response shapes of the App server for run progress, action windows, acting on a set, notes, snooze, batches, undo, similar records and drafted messages. A match acts on the records whose current version is the one the table held at as_of_us, the as_of_us the list or the similar read returned. The server tests assert the server answers with exactly these shapes; the web tests serve these bodies.
